title: Replay
description: A committed player-strategy artifact: a structured capture of the player's actions (policy pivots) that can be replayed headlessly against the current engine. Engine-computed values (inflation, credibility, expectations_anchor) must NOT appear here.

name.description: Localization key for the replay title, e.g. replay.1979_volcker_chair_strategy.name.

desc.description: Localization key for the replay description, e.g. replay.1979_volcker_chair_strategy.desc.

scenario.description: Scenario id this strategy is played against, e.g. scen.1979_volcker.

actions.description: Ordered list of player actions (policy pivots). Only player-controlled inputs — no engine-computed values.

date.description: ISO year-month when this action takes effect, e.g. 1979-08.

policy_rate.description: Target federal funds rate as a decimal, e.g. 0.1075 for 10.75%.
